name: Question 10
problem:
Let $A$ be a $2\times 2$ matrix with eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=3$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=-2$ corresponding to the eigenvectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{2}$ respectively, where

$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Given that the position of a particle at time $t$ seconds is given by the vector $x(t),$ and that $x(t)$ is the solution to the initial value problem

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=Ax(t),\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4\end{aligned}],
$$

find the position of the particle at $t=3$ seconds.
